title: In ksys_unshare of fork.c, there is a possible memory corruption due to a use after free. (CVE-2026-58826)
description: CVE-2026-58826 is a use-after-free vulnerability in the ksys_unshare function within fork.c. This flaw can cause memory corruption and allows local attackers to escalate privileges without requiring additional execution privileges or user interaction.
